why_a_bound_and_not_a_charge: The cancelled session produced no result envelope (SIGTERM leaves none) and its transcript carries zero assistant lines, so there are no retained per-request records to settle from either. #149's rule - settle from the transcript and retain one further request as uncertainty - assumed the transcript held something. Here it holds nothing, so the whole cost is unknown and all of it is retained.
largest_observed_in: P15b-restricted-without-tools-bash, claude-sonnet-5, priced at the pinned rate card
rule: Retained uncertainty comes off the remaining allowance and a terminal stop does not release it. This figure is deliberately conservative: it is an upper bound on an unknown, not an estimate of it.
